name: Nexwise Intelligence China Limited
summary: Nexwise Intelligence China Limited engages in the research, development, and manufacturing, and sale of AI products in China. The company offers KuberCloud Platform, an intelligent cloud computing platform; KuberView, a desktop virtualization product; KuberAI, an autonomous and controllable AI development platform; and KuberFusion, an integrated hyper-converged solution that simplifies cloud infrastructure management.
